name: Generic United States appellate
source_note: Default pack when no state file is selected. Replace with a state pack. Not legal advice. Never files or serves.

deadlines.label: Notice of appeal (placeholder day count)
deadlines.notes: 30 calendar days is a common federal civil default. Confirm the governing rule before using this date.

situations.label: I am appealing
situations.question: Did a trial court enter a decision you want a higher court to review?
situations.why: This generic pack is a placeholder. Install a state pack before relying on a form or a day count. The 30-day figure is marked as a common federal civil default and needs verification.

steps.title: Choose a state pack
steps.why: Generic United States appellate is not a court. A state or circuit pack names the real forms and rules.

teach.what_it_is: A reminder that this pack is a fallback, not a filing kit.
teach.when_used: When no state pack is installed yet.
common_mistakes: Using the 30-day placeholder as if a court had set it.
teach.learn_more: Run packs list, then packs install <state>. Or open Get legal help on JustLegal after the confirmation prompt.
